guide.verdict: Own OAuth2 app, Harvest ID, public use (self-serve (no review step found in the docs)).

composio.note: Harvest is on Composio's managed OAuth list. Switch to your own app when users must see your brand or you need your own quota.

need_own_app.answer: Not for a prototype, because Composio provides a managed Harvest app. For launch, use your own app if users should see your brand on the consent screen or you want a dedicated quota.
reasons: Managed consent screen says 'Composio wants to access your account', not your app name
Managed apps share quota across all Composio users
Managed default scopes may not cover what you need
Managed auth enforces a 15-minute minimum trigger polling interval

scenarios.label: Own OAuth2 app, Harvest ID, public use
scenarios.when_this_applies: You bring your own Harvest OAuth2 app so any customer's users can connect their Harvest accounts through your agent.

hands_on.basis: estimate from step count, not measured

waiting.basis: No review or waiting time was found in the Harvest docs; no timeline source exists.

scenarios.approval: No provider review of the app was found in the docs. Path is inferred from the documented create-app-and-get-credentials flow. Confirm with Harvest if you need certainty.
extras: Administrator login needed to register the app
gate_sequence: Create OAuth2 app in Harvest ID Developers section

modifiers.note: Administrator login needed to register the app

prerequisites.title: Harvest administrator login
prerequisites.detail: Registering an OAuth app requires being logged in as an Administrator on a Harvest account. Source is the v1 docs; v2 docs state no extra requirement.

prerequisites.title: Customer Harvest accounts
prerequisites.detail: API access comes with any Harvest subscription, including free and trial accounts. The docs do not say whether your own app needs a paid plan.

steps.title: Create OAuth2 app in Harvest ID
steps.detail: Log in to Harvest ID as an administrator and create the app in the Developers section. Provide name, redirect URL, multi-account setting and products.
inputs: Redirect URI from the Composio dashboard
steps.done_when: You have a client ID and client secret.

steps.title: Choose products and minimal scope
steps.detail: Decide Harvest, Forecast or both, and whether multi-account access is needed. Harvest advises the minimal scope.
inputs: List of features your agent needs
steps.done_when: Product and multi-account choices are written down before registering.

steps.title: Check redirect URI setup
steps.detail: Copy the redirect URI from the Composio dashboard and confirm it matches the registered Redirect URL. A passed redirect_uri must start with the registered URL.
steps.done_when: Registered Redirect URL matches Composio's callback.

steps.title: Create Composio auth config
steps.detail: Create the harvest auth config through Composio's API using your own client ID and secret.
steps.done_when: Auth config id is returned by Composio.

steps.title: Connect a test account
steps.detail: Authorize a Harvest account through your flow and run one API call. Test again after 18 hours to confirm token refresh.
steps.done_when: A connected account makes a successful call and survives token expiry.

steps.title: Submit integration listing (optional)
steps.detail: Harvest builds an integration page from your copy, images and a support contact. Not documented as required for customers to connect.

traps.title: Greenhouse 'Harvest API' is a different product
traps.detail: Part of the research covers Greenhouse's Harvest API, which needs a signed partnership agreement. That does not apply to Harvest time tracking; do not follow those guides.

traps.title: Access tokens expire in 18 hours
traps.detail: Each user's token expires after 18 hours, so your agent must handle refresh. This comes from the v1 docs; confirm for v2.

traps.title: Managed app shows Composio's name
traps.detail: Users see 'Composio wants to access your account' and share quota with all Composio users.

traps.title: Old v1 docs
traps.detail: Some registration instructions are on deprecated v1 pages. Prefer the v2 Developers section flow.

open_questions: Does Harvest review or limit public OAuth apps? No review or user cap was found; ask Harvest support or test with a second organization's account.
How long does any Harvest approval take, if one exists? No timeline was found; ask Harvest support.
Do the 18-hour token expiry and registration rules still hold in v2? Check the v2 authentication docs or test a token.
